data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'Uuolrich' meaning 'Wealth ruler'. The name Ulrick has been popular among Germanic cultures throughout history, and has been adopted by Christians as a spiritual name. The name Ulrick carries the meaning “Wealth ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ulrick usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
